title: Sudden Death
hook: World Cup final. 4-4. Sudden death. And the last kick is his

messages.text: The World Cup final. Four goals each. Sudden death. And the last kick of the night... belongs to Jay.
messages.label: WORLD CUP FINAL · SUDDEN DEATH

messages.text: Eighty thousand people, and you could hear a pin drop.
But first, Jay had to stop theirs. Their best striker. Top corner, all night long.
messages.label: THEIR KICK

messages.text: Watch the hips. Not the ball. The hips.
WHAT A SAVE! One kick from glory!
Now it was his turn. Score this, and they're world champions. Miss... and it's over.
messages.label: THE LAST KICK

messages.text: Go left, and the keeper's waiting. Swipe too hard, and it flies over the bar. So Jay tried something nobody expected.
A soft little chip... right down the middle... as the keeper dove the wrong way.
It dropped... and dropped... GOAL! World champions!
HE CHIPPED IT! IN A WORLD CUP FINAL!
This is Penalty Shootout. Free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game, so play it on a computer. Would you chip it?
